gp180.choicePolicy: Focus on high-gain, punchy British tones (Marshall/Plexi style) with tight low end and aggressive mids.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A classic Marshall crunch tone achieved using the UK 45 or UK 50 model, paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet simulation. The signal chain emphasizes high-gain distortion and mid-range punch for palm-muted riffing.

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in aggressive riffing.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core aggressive drive and crunch tone required for Foo Fighters' style rock.
blocks.gap: Using the general Distortion model to achieve a Marshall-like saturation without committing to a specific high-gain pedal, allowing flexibility in EQing the mids later.
